stem: Why is clean planting stock important in disease prevention?
choices: It reduces the chance of introducing pathogens into the production system
It lowers visible stress at intake, so symptom-free plants can move into production after a brief visual check instead of a risk-based isolation process
It standardizes early crop vigor, making environmental disease controls less important once the incoming plants establish in the production room
It reduces the need for routine scouting because healthy-looking stock has already been visually screened for the most important biological hazards
rationale: Clean planting material reduces one major introduction pathway for pathogens and pests, but it does not replace quarantine, scouting, sanitation, or environmental disease management.
